notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Cakewalk Loop Manager!
notes.notes:
Cakewalk Loop Manager is Now Available on Steam and is Free to Play!*

Cakewalk Loop Manager is the easiest way for STEAM users to install and utilize loop content inside of Cakewalk Music Creator 6 Touch, SONAR X3, or any Windows Based Digital Audio Workstation that supports REX/WAV/MIDI files.

Also for a limited time all Loops expansion packs from Loopmasters and The Loop Loft are 50% off!*

*Offer ends June 30th at 10AM Pacific Time
